evidence: Ingested data/training_data.csv (800 rows) into Hopsworks feature group leak_train v1 and computed statistics server-side via the platform Trino SQL engine over the offline Delta table. Pearson corr(feature, label): f1=0.135, f2=0.086, f3=0.992, f4=0.097, f5=-0.001, f6=0.006. f3 is ~7x more correlated than any other feature. Per-class f3 distribution is perfectly, non-overlappingly separated: label=0 -> mean 0.001, range [-0.500, 0.491]; label=1 -> mean 2.505, range [2.023, 2.890]. A single threshold on f3 (e.g. f3 > 1.25) classifies every row correctly, which is implausible for a genuine pre-outcome feature -> f3 leaks the outcome (computed from post-outcome data).
